overall: The AG found the Swansea Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving its April 2, 2012 minutes almost a year late, despite acknowledging the delay stemmed partly from uncertainty after board membership changed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to approve the minutes of its April 2, 2012 meeting in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: The Board approved the minutes from the April 2, 2012 meeting almost a year later, even though the Board generally meets monthly.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future conduct may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
